test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the primary benefit of having local self-government institutions like Panchayats in India?

options.text: They are closest to the people and understand local problems
They replace the entire administrative framework of the State
They solely focus on revenue collection.
They provide direct access to national policy-making.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**They are closest to the people and understand local problems**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Local self-government institutions like **Panchayats** play a vital role in **grassroots democracy**.
